'''Inter-Corporate Tribunal''' was the highest judiciary of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It was a independent subdivision of the [[Legal Division]] that dealt with legal suits between small companies and individuals. It was also tasked with mediating disputes between sponsor companies in regards to CSA resources and policies.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
